rationale: 7TM receptors often benefit from separate native-like and expression-engineered construct screens.
suggested_actions: Test the native full-length membrane construct alongside the trimmed membrane construct as the baseline pair.

warnings: Advisory only; not part of the main native construct set.

rationale: Longest internal cytoplasmic loop spans 305-331 (27 aa).

suggested_actions: Create a conservative truncation variant preserving approximately 5-10 residues at each end of loop 305-331.

advanced_membrane_suggestions.summary: Consider an internal cytoplasmic loop engineering series centered on the longest internal cytoplasmic loop, analogous to an ICL3-focused GPCR optimization workflow.

warnings: Advisory only; foreign-fusion constructs are not represented in the main construct tables.

rationale: GPCR-like receptors often tolerate tail engineering better than edits inside the transmembrane bundle.
suggested_actions: Use the trimmed membrane construct as the first tail-engineered variant.

warnings: Evaluate trafficking and signaling, because tail edits can alter regulation and internalization.
